origin.origins.empty.name: Missing
origin.origins.empty.description: You do not have an Origin.
origin.origins.random.name: Random
origin.origins.random.description: You'll be assigned one of the following:
origin.origins.human.name: Human
origin.origins.human.description: A regular human. Your ordinary Minecraft experience awaits.
origin.origins.merling.name: Merling
origin.origins.merling.description: These natural inhabitants of the ocean are not used to being out of the water for too long.
power.origins.merling/water_breathing.de: You can breathe underwater, but not on land.
power.origins.merling/water_vision.name: Wet Eyes
power.origins.merling/aqua_affinity.name: Aqua Affinity
power.origins.merling/aqua_affinity.desc: You may break blocks underwater as others do on land.
power.origins.merling/swim_speed.name: Fins
power.origins.merling/like_water.name: Like Water
power.origins.merling/like_water.descrip: When underwater, you do not sink to the ground unless you want to.
origin.origins.arachnid.name: Arachnid
origin.origins.arachnid.description: Their climbing abilities and the ability to trap their foes in spiderweb make the Arachnid perfect hunters.
power.origins.arachnid/webbing.name: Webbing
power.origins.arachnid/webbing.descripti: When you hit an enemy in melee, they get stuck in cobweb.
power.origins.arachnid/climbing.name: Climbing
power.origins.arachnid/climbing.descript: You are able to climb up any kind of wall, not just ladders.
power.origins.arachnid/master_of_webs.de: You navigate cobweb perfectly, and are able to climb in them. When you hit an enemy in melee, they get stuck in cobweb for a while. Non-arthropods stuck in cobweb will be sensed by you. You are able to craft cobweb from string.
power.origins.arachnid/carnivore.name: Carnivore
power.origins.arachnid/carnivore.descrip: Your diet is restricted to meat, you can't eat vegetables.
power.origins.arachnid/fragile.name: Fragile
power.origins.arachnid/fragile.descripti: You have 3 less hearts of health than humans.
origin.origins.blazeborn.name: Blazeborn
origin.origins.blazeborn.description: Late descendants of the Blaze, the Blazeborn are naturally immune to the perils of the Nether.
power.origins.blazeborn/fire_immunity.de: You are immune to all types of fire damage.
power.origins.blazeborn/nether_spawn.des: Your natural spawn will be in the Nether.
power.origins.blazeborn/burning_wrath.de: When on fire, you deal additional damage with your attacks.
power.origins.blazeborn/hotblooded.name: Hotblooded
power.origins.blazeborn/hotblooded.descr: Due to your hot body, venoms burn up, making you immune to poison and hunger status effects.
power.origins.blazeborn/water_vulnerabil: You receive damage over time while in contact with water.
origin.origins.avian.name: Avian
origin.origins.avian.description: The Avian race has lost their ability to fly a long time ago. Now these peaceful creatures can be seen gliding from one place to another.
power.origins.avian/tailwind.name: Tailwind
power.origins.avian/tailwind.description: You are a little bit quicker on foot than others.
power.origins.avian/featherweight.name: Featherweight
power.origins.avian/featherweight.descri: You fall as gently to the ground as a feather would, unless you sneak.
power.origins.avian/vegetarian.name: Vegetarian
power.origins.avian/fresh_air.name: Fresh Air
power.origins.avian/fresh_air.descriptio: When sleeping, your bed needs to be at an altitude of at least 86 blocks, so you can breathe fresh air.
power.origins.avian/like_air.name: Like Air
power.origins.avian/like_air.description: Modifiers to your walking speed also apply while you're airborne.
power.origins.avian/lay_eggs.name: Oviparous
power.origins.avian/lay_eggs.description: Whenever you wake up in the morning, you will lay an egg.
origin.origins.phantom.name: Phantom
origin.origins.phantom.description: As half-human and half-phantom beings, these creatures can switch between a Phantom and a normal form.
power.origins.phantom/phasing.name: Phasing
power.origins.phantom/phasing.descriptio: While phantomized, you can walk through solid material, except Obsidian.
power.origins.phantom/invisibility.name: Invisibility
power.origins.phantom/hunger_over_time.d: Being phantomized causes you to become hungry.
power.origins.phantom/burn_in_daylight.d: You begin to burn in daylight if you are not invisible.
power.origins.phantom/translucent.name: Translucent
power.origins.phantom/fragile.name: Fragile
power.origins.phantom/fragile.descriptio: You have 3 less hearts of health than humans.
power.origins.phantom/phantomize.name: Phantom Form
power.origins.phantom/phantomize.descrip: You can switch between human and phantom form at will, but only while you are saturated enough to sprint.
origin.origins.feline.name: Feline
origin.origins.feline.description: With their cat-like appearance, the Feline scare creepers away. With the dexterity of cats, they always land safely on their feet.
origin.origins.elytrian.name: Elytrian
origin.origins.elytrian.description: Often flying around in the winds, Elytrians are uncomfortable when they don't have enough space above their head.
origin.origins.enderian.name: Enderian
origin.origins.enderian.description: Born as children of the Ender Dragon, Enderians are capable of teleporting but are vulnerable to water.
origin.origins.shulk.name: Shulk
origin.origins.shulk.description: Related to Shulkers, the bodies of the Shulk are outfitted with a protective shell-like skin.
power.origins.feline/fall_immunity.name: Acrobatics
power.origins.feline/fall_immunity.descr: You never take fall damage, no matter from which height you fall.
power.origins.feline/sprint_jump.name: Strong Ankles
power.origins.feline/sprint_jump.descrip: You are able to jump higher by jumping while sprinting.
power.origins.feline/nine_lives.name: Nine Lives
power.origins.feline/nine_lives.descript: You have 1 less heart of health than humans.
power.origins.feline/cat_vision.name: Nocturnal
power.origins.feline/cat_vision.descript: You can slightly see in the dark when not in water.
power.origins.feline/weak_arms.name: Weak Arms
power.origins.feline/weak_arms.descripti: When not under the effect of a strength potion, you can only mine natural stone if there are at most 2 other natural stone blocks adjacent to it.
power.origins.feline/scare_creepers.name: Catlike Appearance
power.origins.feline/scare_creepers.desc: Creepers are scared of you and will only explode if you attack them first.
power.origins.elytrian/launch_into_air.d: Every 30 seconds, you are able to launch about 20 blocks up into the air.
power.origins.elytrian/elytra.name: Winged
power.origins.elytrian/elytra.descriptio: You have Elytra wings without needing to equip any.
power.origins.elytrian/light_armor.name: Need for Mobility
power.origins.elytrian/light_armor.descr: You can not wear any heavy armor (armor with protection values higher than chainmail).
power.origins.elytrian/claustrophobia.de: Being somewhere with a low ceiling for too long will weaken you and make you slower.
power.origins.elytrian/more_kinetic_dama: You take more damage from falling and flying into blocks.
You deal substantially more damage while in Elytra flight.
power.origins.enderian/throw_ender_pearl: Whenever you want, you may throw an ender pearl which deals no damage, allowing you to teleport.
power.origins.enderian/pumpkin_hate.name: Scared of Gourds
power.origins.enderian/pumpkin_hate.desc: You are afraid of pumpkins. For a good reason.
power.origins.enderian/extra_reach.name: Slender Body
power.origins.enderian/extra_reach.descr: You can reach blocks and entities further away.
power.origins.shulk/shulker_inventory.de: You have access to an additional 9 slots of inventory, which keep the items on death.
power.origins.shulk/natural_armor.name: Sturdy Skin
power.origins.shulk/natural_armor.descri: Even without wearing armor, your skin provides natural protection.
power.origins.shulk/more_exhaustion.name: Large Appetite
power.origins.shulk/more_exhaustion.desc: You exhaust much quicker than others, thus requiring you to eat more.
power.origins.shulk/no_shield.name: Unwieldy
power.origins.shulk/no_shield.descriptio: The way your hands are formed provide no way of holding a shield upright.
power.origins.shulk/strong_arms.name: Strong Arms
power.origins.shulk/strong_arms.descript: You are strong enough to break natural stones without using a pickaxe.
power.origins.feline/velvet_paws.name: Velvet Paws
power.origins.feline/velvet_paws.descrip: Your footsteps don't cause any vibrations which could otherwise be picked up by nearby lifeforms.
origins.gui.swap_origin.title: Swap your %s
origins.gui.swap_origin.empty: You have nothing to swap to.
origins.config.title: Origins Settings
origins.config.gui_theme.seasonal.toolti: Pick the texture by date: rainbow through June, frigid on December 24-26, default the rest of the year.
origins.config.gui_theme.default.tooltip: Always use the default choose-origin screen and Orb of Origin texture.
origins.config.gui_theme.rainbow.tooltip: Always use the rainbow choose-origin screen and Orb of Origin texture.
origins.config.gui_theme.frigid.tooltip: Always use the frigid choose-origin screen and Orb of Origin texture.
power.origins.enderian/water_vulnerabili: You receive damage over time while in contact with water.
power.origins.arachnid/arthropod.name: Arthropod
power.origins.arachnid/arthropod.descrip: You are an arthropod, so weapons enchanted with Bane of Arthropods hurt you far more.
origins.avian_sleep_fail: You need to sleep at a higher altitude, where the air is fresh.
origins.gui.badge.passive: Passive power — always active, no input needed.
